description: The L03-style aisle plus three extra crate stacks drawn by rejection sampling under the minimum-gap constraints. Raises occupied area and shortens sight lines without narrowing the primary route below L00's.
name: l04_static

obstacles.label: storage rack
obstacles.purpose: Blocks part of the aisle and forces a lateral deviation. Its flat 2.4 m face is the primary lidar calibration target: a plane returns a predictable range profile, unlike a cylinder.
